data.summary: Business Analyst with 5.2+ years of Business Analysis experience and 8.5+ years of overall experience in Investment Banking, Capital Markets, and Banking Operations. Experienced in gathering and analyzing business requirements, stakeholder management, BRD/FRD preparation, user stories, acceptance criteria, Agile Scrum, UAT, process mapping, and business process improvement. Possess strong domain expertise in Global Payment Hub Modernization, Payment Processing (SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, Fedwire), Trade Lifecycle Management, OTC Derivatives, and Banking Operations. Proven ability to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams by translating business needs into functional requirements and ensuring successful project delivery. Experienced in conducting workshops, requirement elicitation sessions, impact analysis, gap analysis, process modelling, UAT coordination, production support, and change management. Proficient in Jira, Confluence, SQL, API analysis, Visio, Excel, and Agile methodologies to deliver scalable business solutions aligned with organizational goals.

responsibilities: Gathered business requirements from business users, payment operations teams, compliance teams, and stakeholders.
Conducted requirement elicitation workshops to understand existing payment processes and future business needs.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRD).

Documented AS-IS and TO-BE business process flows for payment modernization.
Performed Gap Analysis to identify process improvements and eliminate manual activities.

Participated in API requirement discussions for payment system integration with internal and external applications.
Performed data mapping between legacy payment systems and the Global Payment Hub.
Worked closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure regulatory requirements were incorporated into business requirements.
Coordinated with QA teams during SIT to validate functional requirements.
Prepared UAT test scenarios, reviewed test cases, supported business users during execution, and obtained business sign-off.
Managed defects during SIT and UAT by coordinating with developers and business stakeholders.
Participated in Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Sprint Review, and Retrospective meetings.
Maintained requirement traceability throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
Supported production deployment, post-production validation, and issue resolution.

projects.name: SOP Process Improvement
projects.description: The objective of this project was to standardize and optimize operational processes by reviewing existing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), identifying process gaps, eliminating manual activities, and improving operational efficiency. The project focused on enhancing workflow standardization, reducing processing time, minimizing operational risks, and improving compliance through process automation and streamlined business workflows.

projects.name: Global Payment Hub Modernization
projects.description: The objective of this project was to modernize the organization's payment infrastructure by replacing multiple legacy payment systems with a centralized Global Payment Hub. The solution enabled seamless processing of domestic and international payments while supporting multiple payment rails such as SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and Fedwire. The project focused on improving payment processing efficiency, reducing operational risk, ensuring regulatory compliance, and enhancing straight-through processing (STP).

projects.name: Trade Lifecycle Dashboard
projects.description: The objective of this project was to develop a centralized Trade Lifecycle Dashboard to provide end-to-end visibility of trade activities across multiple asset classes. The dashboard enabled Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, and Management teams to monitor trade status from execution through settlement by consolidating trade information from multiple upstream and downstream systems. The solution helped improve operational efficiency by reducing manual monitoring, identifying failed trades, tracking settlement exceptions, monitoring KPIs, and providing real-time trade status across the complete trade lifecycle.

projects.name: OTC Derivatives Trade Lifecycle Operations
projects.description: Worked in Investment Banking Operations supporting OTC Derivatives and Trade Lifecycle processes for global financial markets. Responsible for ensuring smooth execution of post-trade operational activities including trade validation, reconciliation, settlement support, exception management, reporting, and stakeholder coordination while maintaining operational accuracy and regulatory compliance.
